definitions.full: H7284. regash [ רְגַשׁ ] verb be in tumult ( ᵑ7 ; Syriac (rare; usually feel, perceive ); see Biblical Hebrew (late, rare)); — Haph`el shew tumultuousness, come thronging: Perfect 3masculine plural הַרְגִּ֫שׁוּ , with עַל person Dan 6:7 ; 6:16 , absolute 6:12 . רֵוֵהּ see [ רֵו ] below ראה . above
